Results.ReviewText: I have to move my grill from it's storage spot and down a 3-inch step to put in a safe place to use it.  I use small ramp blocks so it doesn't drop down and get pulled up that step each time, but still the flimsy table-side lift handle arrangement design isn't holding up to this movement.  It needs a bolt with fastening hardware at the pivot point instead of a sliding nub, which can be pulled out of the folding side table channel bracket.  The grill does a fine job of cooking.  But, this flimsy design is going to cause me to modify the stainless steel folding table hardware.
Results.Title: I want to love it, but, not durable enough

Results.ReviewText:
I purchased this about a month ago and have only used it a few times but I really like this grill.  My previous gas grill (not a Weber) had rusted apart and I was looking for something slightly smaller. 

Assembly was pretty involved but the directions were good and it was a straightforward process.  The material quality seemed better than what I remember from my other, non Weber grill.  I really like that one of the shelves folds down, which helps given the limited space I have to store this grill.

Cooking so far has been great.  Heat seems pretty even and there aren't any hot spots.  I was hesitant at first to spend a similar amount on a grill smaller than the one I had before but the old saying "you get what you pay for" applies here.  So far I think this grill is well worth the extra dollars.  Time will tell if it turns into a rust bucket like my previous grill but the overall material quality and sturdiness give me hope that this will last a long time when properly cared for.
Results.Title: Worth every penny

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
